title: Nice nesting heart containers but not as high quality as I expected
text:
Nice nesting heart containers but not as high quality as I expected. I ordered these containers to store various teas in very small quantities. There are 12 hearts in total with 4 each of 2 ounces, 4 each of 4 ounces, and 4 each of 6.5 ounces. I like that the hearts nest like Russian nesting dolls when the two larger sizes are empty (see photo). What I do not like about these hearts is the clear window. It is made of a plastic that feels like it will easily crack or break. Once that happens these become useless.

If I were using these as one-time only disposable containers, then it would not matter. For instance, these are great for making heart-shaped candles to be given away as gifts, to store candies for party favors, to store tea that is to be sold, as jewelry boxes with the addition of some cotton or felt inserts, etc. However, for permanent storage, they are more on the disposable side. Note the interior surface of some of the containers are a bit marred (scratched up) but that typically does not matter unless one plans to have the interior on display.
